HomePage.metaDescription: Plan trips with an AI travel companion that explains its reasoning, remembers your preferences, and never pressures you to book.

hero.headline: Plan every trip with a companion that remembers you.
hero.subheadline: Tell Atlas where you're dreaming of going. Get a realistic plan, explained clearly, and refined however you like.

aiShowcase.title: Recommendations you can question
aiShowcase.subtitle: Atlas explains its reasoning, so you always understand why something was suggested.
aiShowcase.exampleQuestion: I have 6 days and love good food. Where should I go?
aiShowcase.exampleAnswer: Lisbon fits well — 6 days is enough to explore without rushing, and restaurants are quieter outside peak summer. Want a day-by-day plan?

items.title: Explained, not just generated
items.description: Every recommendation tells you why it's there, and what it assumes.

items.title: Built around your preferences
items.description: Atlas learns your travel style as you go, and you can always see or edit what it remembers.

items.title: Honest about uncertainty
items.description: If something can't be confirmed, Atlas says so instead of guessing.

items.title: No pressure to book
items.description: Atlas recommends. You decide. There's no pressure to book anything.

items.question: Do I need an account to use Atlas?
items.answer: No. You can chat and build a trip as a guest — creating an account just lets you save it for later.

items.question: What languages does Atlas support?
items.answer: Atlas currently supports English, Persian, and German, with more languages planned.

items.question: Is my information kept private?
items.answer: Yes. You control what Atlas remembers, and you can edit or delete it anytime.

items.question: Can Atlas book flights or hotels for me?
items.answer: Not yet. Atlas recommends options — booking happens with your chosen provider.
